notes.title: Update v1.1 - ENDLESS MODE
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43335991/c8b184281d5b3f8194f51a1e89fc8779e5a2826a.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Added ENDLESS mode where you can spawn anything you want
[list]
[*] This mode has a huge Backrooms map that has no enemies.
[*] You can SPAWN anything with buttons 4-9 (instructions are on-screen, includes explosives, ammo..)
[*] You can SPAWN Enemy waves and fight them off. Each wave has incremental enemies.
[*] You can start a fully procedural generator (experimental, exercise caution)
[/list]
[*] Switched Garage and Poolrooms levels order due to difficulty (people struggled in Garage, now it comes later)
[list]
[*] This is a big change that changes the flow of the game:
[*] The Garage level is now moved almost to the end. 
[*] The Poolrooms comes right after Backrooms.
[*] If you were in the middle of the game on the old version, I unlocked every level for you.
[/list]
[*] Made Poolrooms monster weaker
[*] Removed the gameplay feature of broken flickering lights
[*] Headlamp turned off when entering elevator and sitting down at PC
[*] Fixed: If you press "f" and activate the bomb more than once, all inputs break.
[*] Fixed: ui brakes when modding your gun waiting for elevator, if it loads while in modification screen, ui breaks and your cant do anything, not even move 
[*] Laser attachment turns on after equip
[*] Improved graphical performance and glitches
[*] Fixed bug with UI showing old graphic settings after change
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.05
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Decreased headlamp intensity
[*] Lowered cars in the garage level - easier to jump onto
[*] Decreased invisible monster HP
[*] Fixed mistake with Chinese translation (almond water)
[*] Turned off headlamp repeating hints
[*] Added jump hint to garage
[*] Added guiding props in Level 0
[*] Turned up the volume of the radio
[*] Increased maximum allowed UObjects from 2M to 6M
[*] Lowered light intensity near C4 minigame
[*] Added dead body in Poolrooms hole
[*] Changed color of bomb minigame UI frame 
[*] Turned off saving of the headlamp state 
[/list]
